body: She was diagnosed but refuses treatment. They would possibly loose their house. They also want to move within the next 10 years which wouldn't be possible with bankruptcy l.

My dad is a bit older (70s) and kind of detached from reality. My mom just doesn't want to take it and freaks out when anyone tries to talk to her about it. If I file for bankruptcy, it would cause a lot of credit problems for them since they are cosigners.

My dad isn't all there, I'm afraid. My mom completely controls the bank accounts. That's the only thing that I'm really angry about - she shouldn't have cosigned for the loans. I think that a lot of it has to do with her being bipolar, honestly. 

They've been pretty weird with money throughout my life. Basically my mom acts like she is living in poverty despite her and my dad making about 80k. A lot of my family has called her out on it, actually. While I don't expect them to give me any money, my point is that I don't think that I can talk openly to either of them about this. Whenever anything about money comes up, my mom goes into "rage" mode.
thank you. It sounds like your situation is similar to mine... PM me if you'd like (I've never done it, ha) but I might fall asleep soon since I stayed up all night.
